run_bm25_retriever: run a BM25 retriever to search a Pyserini index and return top-k document hits for each query
create_bm25_instance: create a BM25 retriever instance with a given index path, top-k results, and thread count
feed_queries_to_bm25: feed a list of query dictionaries with id and query fields into the BM25 retriever for chunked processing
run_bm25_thread: run a single-threaded BM25 search using a Pyserini SimpleSearcher on a chunk of queries
review_bm25_class: review the BM25 retriever class that extends Retriever and uses ThreadPool for parallel query processing
